City Council
AGENDA
la puente City Council
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
OCTOBER 24, 2006
7:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCILMEMBERS: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Perez, Chavez
BOARD MEMBERS: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Perez, Chavez
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Redevelopment Agency on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker’s remarks. (Ordinance No. 98-767).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF OCTOBER 10, 2006
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of October 10, 2006.
Minutes 10-10-06 Reg
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1 PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER AN INTERIM ORDINANCE EXTENDING THE MORATORIUM ON SMOKE SHOPS IN LA PUENTE
It is recommended that City Council (1) open the public hearing; (2) take public testimony; (3) read ordinance by title only and waive further reading; and (4) introduce the Ordinance extending the moratorium on "smoke shops" for 10 months, 15 days.
Smoke Shop Moratoriam Exten - Report
Smoke Shop Moratoriam Exten - Ordinance
B-2 PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENT NO. 123, A PROPOSED ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE AMENDING CHAPTER 10.74, SIGNS AND ADVERTISING REGULATIONS, TO ALLOW PYLON-SUPPORTED FREESTANDING SIGNS AND AMENDING REGULATIONS RELATED TO HEIGHT, NUMBER AND SIZE OF FREESTANDING SIGNS
It is recommended that the City Council (1) open the public hearing; (2) take public testimony; (3) read ordinance by title only and waive further reading; and (4) introduce the Ordinance for subsequent adoption.
Muni Code Amend 123 - Report
Muni Coe Amed 123 - Ordinance
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF PROPOSAL FOR CURB ADDRESS NUMBER PAINTING SERVICES THROUGHOUT THE CITY
It is recommended that the City Council award the proposal for curb address number painting services throughout the City to Canning Hunger in conjunction with Delhaven Community Center.
Curb Address Number Painting Report
CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1189 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2006-07
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution.
Warrant Register No. 1189
D-2
FINANCIAL REPORT FOR MONTH OF AUGUST 31, 2006
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the un-audited Monthly Financial Report for the month ended August 31, 1006.
Fin Report for 8-31-06
D-3
FINANCIAL REPORT FOR MONTH OF SEPTEMBER 30, 2006
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the un-audited Monthly Financial Report for the month ended September 30, 2006.
Fin Report for 9-30-06
D-4
ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION DESIGNATING INDIVIDUALS TO SIGN BANK CARDS FOR PURPOSES OF CONDUCTING CITY BUSINESS AND RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 05-4484 AUTHORIZING SIGNATURES ON CHECKS, DRAFTS, AND WARRANTS
It is recommended that the City Council consider adopting the resolution designating City Staff authorized to sign bank cards.
Authorized Signatures Bank Cards - Report
Authorized Signatures Bank Cards - Reso
D-5
ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION DIRECTING DEPOSITORIES FOR CITY FUNDS TO HONOR INVESTMENT TRANSACTIONS AND RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 05-4483
It is recommended that the City Council consider adopting the resolution directing depositories to honor investment transactions on the order of designated City Staff.
Authorized Signatures Investment Transactions - Report
Authorized Signatures Investment Transaction - Reso
D-6
ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION REGARDING THE INVESTMENT OF CITY MONIES IN THE LOCAL AGENCY INVESTMENT FUND AND RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 05-4482
It is recommended that the City Council consider adopting the resolution authorizing City officers to deposit/withdraw City monies to/from the Local Agency Investment Fund (LAIF).
Authorized Signatures LAIF - Report
Authorized Signatures LAIF - Reso
D-7
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM FY 2006-07
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agenda report of the City Manager and authorize that it be filed for audit.
CDBG Monthly Report
D-8
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CALHOME HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM ROUND 2
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agenda report of the City Manager and authorize that it be filed for audit.
Calhome Housing Monthly Report
D-9
APPROVAL OF NEW PARTICIPANT(S) FOR CALHOME REHABILITATION PROGRAM FOR ROUND TWO FUNDING
The Screening Committee recommends that the City Council authorize the Community Development Director to execute the necessary documents to implement the Housing Rehabilitation Program in the amount of $40,000.
Calhome Rehab Participant(s) Report
D-10
APPROVAL OF NEW PARTICIPANT(S) FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM (D97301-07) - FISCAL YEAR 2006-07
The Screening Committee recommends that the City Council approve the allocations and authorize the Community Development Director to execute the necessary documents to implement the Housing Rehabilitation Program in the amount of $5,000.
CDBG Housing Participant(s) Report
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1.
CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING A RESOLUTION SUPPORTING PROPOSITION 86 - THE TOBACCO TAX ACT OF 2006
None
Proposition 86 Report
RECESS CITY COUNCIL AND CONVENE THE REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
COUNCIL REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION
F-1
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54957 PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT - CITY MANAGER
RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION

City Council
MINUTES
LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL
REGULAR MEETING OF
October 24, 2006
A Regular Meeting of the City Council of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on October 24, 2006, at 7:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF OCTOBER 10, 2006
Minutes 10-10-06 Reg
Perez moved to waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of October 10, 2006; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1 PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER AN INTERIM ORDINANCE EXTENDING THE MORATORIUM ON SMOKE SHOPS IN LA PUENTE
Smoke Shop Moratoriam Exten - Report
Smoke Shop Moratoriam Exten - Ordinance
Perez moved to adopt the Urgency Ordinance extending the moratorium on "smoke shops" for 10 months, 15 days ; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
B-2 PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENT NO. 123, A PROPOSED ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE AMENDING CHAPTER 10.74, SIGNS AND ADVERTISING REGULATIONS, TO ALLOW PYLON-SUPPORTED FREESTANDING SIGNS AND AMENDING REGULATIONS RELATED TO HEIGHT, NUMBER AND SIZE OF FREESTANDING SIGNS
Muni Code Amend 123 - Report
Muni Coe Amed 123 - Ordinance
Perez moved to read the ordinance by title only, waive further reading and introduce the Ordinance for subsequent adoption; seconded by Lujan.
Perez moved to introduce the Ordinance for subsequent adoption; seconded by Lujan.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF PROPOSAL FOR CURB ADDRESS NUMBER PAINTING SERVICES THROUGHOUT THE CITY
Curb Address Number Painting Report
Perez moved to award the proposal for curb address number painting services throughout the City to Canning Hunger in conjunction with Delhaven Community Center; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
CONSENT CALENDAR
Action Taken :
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
